# xSuit

> > xSuit offers performance menswear featuring machine-washable, wrinkle-free suits and dress clothing with stretch fabric technology.

xSuit specializes in technical formal wear including the xSuit 5.0, xJacket, xPant, xShirt, and xSweater collections made from innovative materials like TechWool, Supima cotton, and Merino wool. All products feature performance characteristics like 4-way or 8-way stretch, wrinkle resistance, and machine washability for modern professionals.

- xSuit 5.0 Three-Piece
